newsitem.title: USA: Central European Media ends PULS-TV funding.
newsitem.headline: Central European Media ends PULS-TV funding.

text.p: Central European Media Enterprises Ltd said Tuesday it would stop funding PULS-TV, the regional television station for Berlin and Brandenburg.
The company, in a statement released in New York, also said it will take a writedown of about $20 million against its German operations.
Central European Media said it has been the only PULS-TV partner supporting the station's losses for the past 18 months. It said the station was losing about two million marks a month.
Since December 1996, the partners have attempted to find new investors and new management to guide the station but the effort has not succeeded, the company said.
It said the other partners are Ulrich Schamoni, Time Warner Inc's German unit, George Soros, and APA Falladium GmbII.
As a result of being the only partner funding PULS-TV's losses since the 1995 fourth quarter, Central European Media's ownership of the station has grown to over 59 percent, it said.
